source_evidence:
Day328 exact player 'No this is good.

I am surprised that this scale of operation has not been approached or taken over by organized crime yet' approves Desen sending the already stated assurances with no additions, and raises an observation about the local association. Desen explains that a coordinated illicit freight association buying inspection information is itself organized crime, despite its legitimate trade and respectable members. Three boats, two leased storehouses and political contacts do not establish control of the entire river or membership in a larger criminal network; no evidence currently held identifies a separate group trying to take it over, and Desen does not claim that no such group exists. He sends his plainclothes messenger back with the exact limited assurances: private voluntary interview, freedom to leave, consideration of lawful protection if credible danger, no guaranteed immunity, concealment from a court or private settlement payment. Before rolling DM fixed independent Sornell decision d20 1–7 declines for now, 8–20 agrees to speak. Actual user-visible Python secrets receipt batch f39b2c257661c876c2d2f1cd0ae8748a, face10, agrees. Messenger actually reaches Sornell and receives agreement; ordinary arrangements bring Sornell to a private room borrowed through Desen's existing customs-examiner contact at ~14:30, away from the storehouses. V and companions accompany Desen under prior authorization. Sornell comes voluntarily, without original ledgers, escorted only for directions not detained; no actual new threat, proven secret surveillance, resignation, immunity, settlement, sworn testimony or payment. Sornell opens 'You said I could leave when we are finished. I am here to speak, not to sign my life away.' Desen confirms voluntary status, and asks what has been happening with the promised settlement. Sornell glances at V, awaiting response before explaining. No new factual testimony yet, no link to murders or larger organization invented. No other resource or custody changes. V chooses next action.
